# CSRA Marketing

> CSRA Marketing (Contractor Search & Revenue Agency) builds websites and runs local SEO for roofing companies nationwide. We turn a roofing company's Google presence into booked jobs.

## About

CSRA Marketing is a web design and local SEO agency exclusively serving roofing companies. The agency's operating model: the founder sells, AI builds the websites, and vetted freelancers handle SEO fulfillment. Based in Grovetown, Georgia. Serving roofers nationwide.

- Website: https://csramarketing.com/
- Contact: https://csramarketing.com/contact/
- About: https://csramarketing.com/about/

## Services

### Website Design for Roofers
- Custom 9-page websites built for roofing companies
- 7-day delivery timeline
- 2 revision rounds included
- Details: https://csramarketing.com/web-design/

### Local SEO for Roofers
- $1,500/month, 6-month term
- Google Business Profile management and map pack rankings
- Review generation and response
- Local content pages and citation building
- 2-3 authority links per month
- Details: https://csramarketing.com/local-seo/

### SEO Sprints (one-time)
- SEO Audit: $697
- Google Business Profile Overhaul: $897
- Citation Cleanup & Building: $597

### Website Care Plan
- $65/month: managed hosting, SSL, performance monitoring, 3 change credits/month
